## Checklist

- [ ] Tests: I added or updated tests for the change, and they pass (`cargo test` for the crates I touched; see CONTRIBUTING.md for the checks the project runs).
- [ ] FEATURES.md: if a feature was added or changed, its row is updated honestly (Impl and Test numbers say only what was run).
- [ ] No personal data: no names, e-mail addresses, home paths, host names, IP addresses of my machines, keys or tokens in the code, the docs, the tests or the commit messages.
- [ ] Licence: my code is mine to contribute under Apache-2.0, and any new dependency has a permissive licence (`cargo deny check` passes).
- [ ] Every user-facing feature has a chat tool, and anything that changes the machine asks for approval.
- [ ] Every commit has a `Signed-off-by` line (see below).

## Developer Certificate of Origin

By contributing I certify the Developer Certificate of Origin 1.1 (https://developercertificate.org/): the contribution is mine, or I have the right to submit it under the project's licence. Add the line with `git commit -s`:

```
Signed-off-by: Your Name <your.email@example.com>
```
